hero.heroesjourney.batman_nolan.descript: Become Gotham's Dark Knight: training, investigation, and a reckoning with the League of Shadows.
gui.heroesjourney.roster.title: Heroes
gui.heroesjourney.confirm_activate.title: Switch hero?
gui.heroesjourney.confirm_activate.messa: Really activate %s? The previous hero's abilities will be removed.
dialogue.heroesjourney.prisoner_a.start: The key? I think it's hidden under the guard's bed, west wing. Trust me.
dialogue.heroesjourney.prisoner_b.start: Listen carefully: a chest in the east wing, hidden under the straw. Hurry, the patrol is coming.
dialogue.heroesjourney.henri.start: The mind must be as disciplined as the body. Ken handles your training; I merely observe.
dialogue.heroesjourney.ken.too_early: Come back when you're ready to learn.
dialogue.heroesjourney.ken.training_brie: Three trials await you: defeat thirty enemies bare-handed, cover great distances at a run, and land fifteen strikes undetected. Prove your worth.
dialogue.heroesjourney.ken.order: A prisoner has betrayed the Order. The sentence is death. Carry it out.
quest.heroesjourney.batman.1.title: On Your Parents' Grave
quest.heroesjourney.batman.1.description: Find Wayne Manor and pay respects at Thomas and Martha Wayne's graves.
quest.heroesjourney.batman.2.title: Understanding the Criminal Mind
quest.heroesjourney.batman.2.description: Infiltrate the prison, cross-reference the prisoners' accounts, and escape.
quest.heroesjourney.batman.3.title: The League of Shadows' Training
quest.heroesjourney.batman.3.description: Complete the three trials Ken sets at the monastery.
quest.heroesjourney.batman.4.title: The Refusal
quest.heroesjourney.batman.4.description: Refuse Ken's order and face him.
quest.heroesjourney.batman.5.title: Becoming the Bat
quest.heroesjourney.batman.5.description: Craft and wear the complete Dark Knight suit.
quest.heroesjourney.batman.6.title: Fear Itself
quest.heroesjourney.batman.6.description: Find Arkham Asylum and defeat Scarecrow.
quest.heroesjourney.batman.7.title: The Train of Fear
quest.heroesjourney.batman.7.description: Henri reveals himself as the true Ra's al Ghul. Face him aboard the train.
objective.heroesjourney.batman.run_dista: Cover a long distance at a run
